key: 1. How do I discover and book a vendor on Magizhnaazh?
html: 1. How do I discover and book a vendor on Magizhnaazh?

key: Browse our Marketplace tab by selecting your city (e.g. Coimbatore, Chennai, Madurai) and category (Catering, Venues, Decor, Photography, etc.). Click View Details to review portfolios, pricing packages, and past ratings. Once selected, click Book Vendor to request your booking date.
html: Browse our Marketplace tab by selecting your city (e.g. Coimbatore, Chennai, Madurai) and category (Catering, Venues, Decor, Photography, etc.). Click View Details to review portfolios, pricing packages, and past ratings. Once selected, click Book Vendor to request your booking date.

key: 2. How do advance payments work?
html: 2. How do advance payments work?

key: When booking a vendor, you submit an advance payment claim. Magizhnaazh holds this in your booking ledger until the vendor verifies availability and confirms the booking. You can monitor the real-time status under My Orders.
html: When booking a vendor, you submit an advance payment claim. Magizhnaazh holds this in your booking ledger until the vendor verifies availability and confirms the booking. You can monitor the real-time status under My Orders.

key: 3. How does the Smart Budget Planner work?

key: Our Smart Budget Planner automatically divides your total target budget across essential categories (Venues, Catering, Stage Decor, Photography, Makeup, Gifts). Whenever you confirm a vendor booking, the cost is automatically deducted from your remaining allocation.
html: Our Smart Budget Planner automatically divides your total target budget across essential categories (Venues, Catering, Stage Decor, Photography, Makeup, Gifts). Whenever you confirm a vendor booking, the cost is automatically deducted from your remaining allocation.

key: 4. Can I customize digital invitations?
